integrity: The antipodal support-width and exact side-normal classification are proved for arbitrary dimensions n>=3; the defect identity and homology correspondence are cited established theorems. No exhaustive-priority or independent-certification claim.
limitations: Only right regular antiprisms with n>=3, positive base radius and height; not arbitrary prismatoids.
Published general defect and homology formulas are credited prior results.
Full text of the motivating 45-page preprint could not be inspected; historical priority remains provisional.
Finite numerical verifier is corroboration, not an infinite proof; independent audit not performed.
title: A parity law for antipodal pairs and the antipodal defect of regular antiprisms
